verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents its own team features that share conversation state across teammates. Read statuses are shared across the team, and reply indicators show when a teammate is replying so people avoid collisions. There is no documented shared-inbox or shared-account capability, and the 'share live email views' quote is phrased generically about collaboration tools rather than as a clear Superhuman feature. missing for 10: explicit shared inbox/shared account support, team channels with unified assignment/conversation state, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Team Read Statuses: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.
Team Reply Indicators: See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.
